2.
City Council Meetings Update.
Mr. McNamara gave a report on City Council meeting actions to the Planning Commission.
DISCUSSION ITEMS FROM THE PLANNING COMMISSIONERS
Commissioner Millner stated the City was being proactive in maintaining infrastrure with Mr. McNamara making additional comments to City Council credit.
Commissioner Lee had no commernt.
Commissionr Kindred would participate with comments in the future.
Commissioner Dodson made general comments to City of Azusa.
Commissioner Kindred stated she was impressed the City is solvent, specially to the rebate program from Light and Water Department.
Commissioner Alva reported Cerritos Avenue needs attention and repair near Gladstone.
Commissioner Dodson congratulated the new commission members,and made a friendly reminder about the brown act.
Mr. McNamara stated next Planning Commission meeting would be October 28, 2009, also on Wednesday, November 11, 2009 no meeting for it is a Holiday. So a tentative Planning Commission meeting was discussed for November 18, 2009, would be determined at an upcoming meeting. He did not arrive at a consensus for a meeting with the Commissioners for the month of December.
